caption: Temple of Olympian Zeus, Athens
composition: Corinthian columns of the Olympieion in skyglow, Acropolis beyond · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Inside the Olympieion precinct, looking northwest, a cluster of tall Corinthian columns still carries a length of entablature, with other columns standing apart and one fallen column of drums on the grass. The Acropolis is a separate warm shape in the distance. The sky is clear, about 12.2°C. No official lighting timetable was found for this hour, so the Olympieion columns are in city skyglow only, not under floodlights.
